name: meetdossie-video-engine
description: Local video engine deps. Deliberately NOT in the repo-root package.json: sharp and onnxruntime-node are ~300MB of native binaries used only by these local scripts, never by anything under api/, and the root manifest is what Vercel installs on every deploy. Node resolves scripts/video-engine/node_modules before walking up, so `npm install` in THIS directory is all that is needed. Run it once per machine, alongside download-models.sh.
